## Savings Flags and Key Insights
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/graph-down.svg

- **Savings below CAD 1,450:** **2025-05** at **CAD 1,445**.
- Income rose from **CAD 7,200** to **CAD 7,400**, but savings did not rise at the same pace.
- **Childcare** was the most stable expense at **CAD 900/month**, making it the biggest fixed cost after rent.
- **Rent** increased by **CAD 50** starting in April, which pushed total expenses higher.
- **Groceries** trended upward overall, peaking in **May at CAD 860**, which also coincided with the lowest savings month.
